'''Gleezwuq''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] criminal who was a member of [[Blix Lanister]]'s gang during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
[[File:BlixBlaster.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Blix Lanister]]'s [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], used to murder [[Alita Sweetwater]] in [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].]]
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]], [[Windy Starkiller]] resided in the [[City/Legends|town]] of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. While here, he asked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to find the wanted murderer, [[Blix Lanister]], who had fled town.<ref name="AED" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
The spacer agreed to carry out the task, and found Blix shortly thereafter. Blix was brought back to Windy, who paid the spacer 30 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in thanks. He even said the spacer should consider a career as a security officer. Yet the situation with Blix did not end there. Windy also wanted the spacer to find one of Blix's gang members, a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] named Gleezwuq. Gleezwuq was the only member of Blix's gang that Windy did not know the location of. He was sure that Gleezwuq would have evidence which would implicate Blix in his murder of [[Alita Sweetwater]].<ref name="AED" />

The spacer managed to find the Rodian gang member, and killed him. On Gleezwuq's person was the same [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] that Blix used in his murder of Alita. The spacer brought the blaster back to an impressed Windy, who was now certain that Blix could be brought to justice.<ref name="AED" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateThug.png|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Gleezwuq, including three male Rodian depictions which may be canon in Legends]]
Gleezwuq was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. Players who performed a series of [[:w:c:Quest|quests]] for [[Windy Starkiller]] had to escort [[Blix Lanister]] to [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]], kill Gleezwuq outside of [[City/Legends|town]], and then kill Lanister when he escaped from Anchorhead. The series of quests involved implicating Blix Lanister in the murder of [[Alita Sweetwater]].<ref name="AED" />

Because Gleezwuq spawned under the generic "thug" template, his appearance was randomized under one of thirty-five possible depictions. [[Species/Legends|Species]] Gleezwuq could appear as included [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]], [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]], [[Bith/Legends|Bith]], [[Human/Legends|Humans]], Rodians, [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshans]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], and [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] of either gender. Because the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue identified Gleezwuq as a male Rodian, this article assumes that one of the three randomly generated male Rodian depictions is [[canon]] in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity. For unknown reasons, Windy was removed from ''Star Wars Galaxies'' less than a year after its release, during [[:w:c:swg:Publish 6 Notes:11 February 04|Publish 6]] on [[February 11]], [[2004]].<ref name="AED" />
